articleTitle: How to Calculate Raw Ingredient Amounts From Weekly Macros
imageHeadline: From Macro Targets to Pounds of Food

pinDescription: Set your protein, carb, and fat targets? Here's how to figure out exactly how much chicken, rice, or other ingredients to buy each week. This straightforward guide breaks down the math that connects macro goals to real grocery quantities for easier meal prep.
